en.L: For the director. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Un psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro. Salmo de David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Salmo de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Canto de David.

vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Thi thiên của Đa-vít.

pt.B: Para o mestre de música. Salmo de Davi.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. Canção de Davi.

hi.L: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। दाऊद का भजन।
hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। दाऊद का भजन।
hi.R: गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। दाऊद का गीत।

ja.L: 指揮する者のために。ダビデの賛歌。
ja.B: 音楽を導く者のために。ダビデの賛歌。
ja.R: 音楽を導く人のために。ダビデの歌。

uk.R: Для того, хто керує співом. Пісня Давида.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1, Readable says what a psalm is.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 20.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

source.text: יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם׀אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: May YHWH answer you in [the] day of trouble; may [the] name of [the] God of Jacob set you on high.

en.L: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answer you in [the] day of trouble; \q may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.
en.B: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answer you when trouble comes; \q may the God of Jacob, by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, keep you safe on the heights.
en.R: We pray that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will answer you when you are in trouble. \q May the God of Jacob protect you by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power.

fr.L: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te réponde au jour de la détresse ; \q que le nom du Dieu de Jacob te place en haut lieu.
fr.B: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te réponde quand vient la détresse ; \q que le Dieu de Jacob, par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, te garde en sûreté sur les hauteurs.
fr.R: Nous prions pour que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te réponde quand tu es dans le malheur. \q Que le Dieu de Jacob te protège par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akujibu siku ya taabu; jina la Mungu wa Yakobo likuweke juu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akujibu taabu inapokuja; Mungu wa Yakobo, kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, akulinde salama juu milimani.
sw.R: Tunaomba kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakujibu unapokuwa taabuni. Mungu wa Yakobo akulinde kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

es.L: Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te responda en [el] día de la angustia; \q que el nombre del Dios de Jacob te ponga en alto.
es.B: Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te responda cuando llegue la angustia; \q que el Dios de Jacob, por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, te guarde seguro en las alturas.
es.R: Pedimos que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te responda cuando estés en problemas. \q Que el Dios de Jacob te proteja con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder.

vi.L: Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời vua trong ngày gian truân; nguyện danh của Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp đặt vua lên nơi cao.
vi.B: Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời vua khi hoạn nạn đến; nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp, bởi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, giữ vua an toàn trên nơi cao.
vi.R: Chúng tôi cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời vua khi vua gặp hoạn nạn. Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp dùng quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bảo vệ vua.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 환난의 날에 왕께 응답하시고, 야곱의 하나님의 이름이 왕을 높이 두시기를 [빕니다].
ko.B: 환난이 닥칠 때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕께 응답하시고, 야곱의 하나님께서 그분의 이름으로 왕을 높은 곳에 안전하게 지켜 주시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 왕께서 어려움을 당하실 때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 응답해 주시기를 우리가 기도합니다. 야곱의 하나님께서 그분의 능력으로 왕을 지켜 주시기를 빕니다.

pt.L: Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe responda no dia da angústia; \q que o nome do Deus de Jacó o ponha no alto.
pt.B: Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe responda quando vier a aflição; \q que o Deus de Jacó, pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, o guarde seguro nas alturas.
pt.R: Oramos para que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe responda nos momentos de dificuldade. \q Que o Deus de Jacó o proteja com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በመከራ ቀን ይመልስልህ፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ስም ከፍ ባለ ስፍራ ያኑርህ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ችግር በመጣ ጊዜ ይመልስልህ፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ በስሙ ማንም በማይደርስበት ከፍታ ላይ ይጠብቅህ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በችግር ላይ ስትሆን እንዲመልስልህ እንጸልያለን። የያዕቆብ አምላክ በኃይሉ ይጠብቅህ።

hi.L: संकट के दिन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} आपको उत्तर दें; याकूब के परमेश्वर का नाम आपको ऊँचे पर रखे।
hi.B: जब संकट आए, तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} आपको उत्तर दें; याकूब के परमेश्वर अपने नाम के द्वारा आपको ऊँचाइयों पर सुरक्षित रखें।
hi.R: हमारी प्रार्थना है कि जब आप संकट में हों, तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} आपको उत्तर दें। याकूब के परमेश्वर अपनी शक्ति से आपकी रक्षा करें।

ru.L: Да ответит тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} в день скорби; да поставит тебя на высоте имя Бога Иакова.
ru.B: Пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответит тебе, когда придёт беда; пусть Бог Иакова своим именем хранит тебя в безопасности на высотах.
ru.R: Мы молимся, чтобы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответил тебе, когда ты в беде. Пусть Бог Иакова защитит тебя своей силой.

ja.L: 苦難の日に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに答えてくださるように。ヤコブの神の名が、あなたを高く上げるように。
ja.B: 苦しみが来るとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに答えてくださるように。ヤコブの神が、その名によって、あなたを高い所で守ってくださるように。
ja.R: 苦しいとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに答えてくださるように。ヤコブの神が、その力で、あなたを守ってくださるように。

uk.L: Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} відповість тобі в день скрути; нехай імʼя Бога Якова поставить тебе на висоті.
uk.B: Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} відповість тобі, коли прийде біда; нехай Бог Якова своїм іменем береже тебе на висотах.
uk.R: Ми молимося, щоб {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} відповів тобі, коли ти в біді. Нехай Бог Якова захищає тебе своєю силою.

decisions.choice: you: the king
decisions.reason: The psalm is a prayer of the people ("we", verse 6) for their king (verses 7 and 10), probably before he goes out to battle. Psalm 21 gives thanks for the answer.

decisions.choice: set you on high: put you out of reach
decisions.reason: The verb (sagav) means to set high and safe, as in a stronghold on a height (9:10). The name of God is God himself, present and acting for his people.

decisions.choice: We pray that
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the people are praying for the king (m1).

decisions.choice: by his power
decisions.reason: Readable says what the name stands for here (m2).

decisions.choice: the king is addressed with "tu", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: In this psalm the people pray for the king (m1), so "tu" and "te" are ordinary pronouns for a man; only the pronouns for God carry the setting.

decisions.choice: te, tu (the king)
decisions.reason: The people pray for their king. Spanish speaks to him with "tú", as the Hebrew speaks to him directly; these pronouns are not for God and take no deity pronoun setting, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "vua" (the king) for "you" through the psalm, and "chúng tôi" for the people
decisions.reason: The people are praying for their king (see the meaning decision). Vietnamese addresses a superior by his title, and "vua" is plain and respectful; "bệ hạ" belongs to court speech, and "ngài" would be confused with the pronoun for God.

decisions.choice: The "you" of verses 2-6 is the king (meaning decision m1), addressed as "왕" with 합쇼체 and the honorific
alternatives: 너 and 해라체, as in a blessing between equals (Psalm 121)
decisions.reason: The people bless their king before battle; Korean speaks to a king by his title and with respect, not with a pronoun. The people call themselves "우리" here, since they speak to the king, and "저희" when they turn to God in verse 10. Psalm 21:9-13 follows the same choice.

decisions.choice: lhe, o, seu (the forms that go with "o senhor"), without a subject pronoun
decisions.reason: The people speak to their king (m1). A king is addressed as "o senhor", but the noun beside "o SENHOR" would confuse every line, and "você" is too familiar for a king; so the psalm uses only the object and possessive forms that belong to "o senhor" ("lhe", "o", "seu"), which Portuguese can do without naming the addressee. "Tu" is kept for God.

decisions.choice: "you" as "አንተ" (ይመልስልህ, ይጠብቅህ): the people speak to their king
decisions.reason: The people pray for the king (meaning decision m1) in a song he leads in worship; the psalm speaks to him plainly, as the Hebrew does, and keeps the familiar form through the psalm. A reviewer may prefer the respectful "እርስዎ" for a king.

decisions.choice: "आप" to the king
decisions.reason: The people pray for the king and speak to him (m1). As the poetry terms note settles for Psalms 20, 21, 45 and 72, he is addressed with "आप", as people address the king in Samuel and Kings; "तू" stays for God.

decisions.choice: honorific forms for God; no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God is spoken of with honorific forms ("वे", "उनके") through the psalm.

decisions.choice: "ты" to the king
decisions.reason: The people pray for their king (m1). As the notes settle, Russian says "ты" for the Hebrew singular "you", also to a king; respect is carried by the words, not by "вы".

decisions.choice: "своим именем" (B), "своей силой" (R), no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English has a span on "his name", "his power"; Russian refers back to the subject, the God of Jacob, with the reflexive "свой", which takes none. The same holds for "свой" of God through this psalm.

decisions.choice: The people's wishes for the king (20:2-6) as "〜てくださるように" (God's act with a light respect form), the king addressed plainly as "あなた"
decisions.reason: "答えられるように" could be read "so that you can be answered"; the plain wish form keeps the Psalter's register, with the R "We pray that" carried by 〜ように.

records.literal_gloss: May he send your help from [the] sanctuary, and from Zion may he support you.

en.L: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} send your help from the sanctuary, \q and from Zion may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sustain you.
en.B: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} send you help from the holy place \q and hold you up from Zion.
en.R: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} send help to you from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple. \q May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} give you strength from Mount Zion.

fr.L: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’envoie ton secours du sanctuaire, \q et que de Sion {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te soutienne.
fr.B: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’envoie de l’aide du lieu saint \q et te soutienne depuis Sion.
fr.R: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’envoie de l’aide de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple. \q Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te donne des forces depuis le mont Sion.

sw.L: Akupelekee msaada wako kutoka mahali patakatifu, na kutoka Sayuni akutegemeze.
sw.B: Akutumie msaada kutoka mahali patakatifu na kukushika kutoka Sayuni.
sw.R: Akutumie msaada kutoka hekaluni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. Akupe nguvu kutoka Mlima Sayuni.

es.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} envíe tu ayuda desde el santuario, \q y desde Sion te sostenga.
es.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te envíe ayuda desde el lugar santo \q y te sostenga desde Sion.
es.R: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te mande ayuda desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te dé fuerzas desde el monte Sion.

vi.L: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai sự giúp đỡ đến cho vua từ nơi thánh, và từ Si-ôn nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nâng đỡ vua.
vi.B: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ nơi thánh sai sự giúp đỡ đến cho vua và từ Si-ôn nâng đỡ vua.
vi.R: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai sự giúp đỡ đến cho vua. Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ núi Si-ôn ban sức mạnh cho vua.

ko.L: 그분께서 성소에서 왕을 도우실 것을 보내시고, 시온에서 왕을 붙드시기를 [빕니다].
ko.B: 그분께서 거룩한 곳에서 왕께 도움을 보내시고, 시온에서 왕을 붙들어 주시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 그분께서 그분의 성전에서 왕께 도움을 보내 주시기를 빕니다. 시온산에서 왕께 힘을 주시기를 빕니다.

pt.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe envie socorro desde o santuário, \q e de Sião {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o sustente.
pt.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe mande ajuda do lugar santo \q e o sustente desde Sião.
pt.R: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe mande ajuda do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe dê forças desde o monte Sião.

am.B: ከቅዱሱ ስፍራ ርዳታ ይላክልህ፤ ከጽዮንም ደግፎ ያቁምህ።
am.R: ከቤተ መቅደሱ ርዳታ ይላክልህ። ከጽዮን ተራራም ብርታት ይስጥህ።

hi.L: वे पवित्रस्थान से आपके लिए सहायता भेजें, और सिय्योन से आपको सँभालें।
hi.B: वे पवित्र स्थान से आपको सहायता भेजें और सिय्योन से आपको थामे रहें।
hi.R: वे अपने मन्दिर से आपके पास सहायता भेजें। वे सिय्योन पर्वत से आपको बल दें।

ru.L: Да пошлёт {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} тебе помощь из святилища и с Сиона да подкрепит тебя.
ru.B: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} пошлёт тебе помощь из святого места и с Сиона поддержит тебя.
ru.R: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} пошлёт тебе помощь из своего храма. Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даст тебе силы с горы Сион.

ja.L: その方が聖所からあなたの助けを送り、シオンからあなたを支えてくださるように。
ja.B: その方が聖なる所からあなたに助けを送り、シオンからあなたを支えてくださるように。
ja.R: その方が神殿からあなたに助けを送り、シオンの山からあなたに力を与えてくださるように。

uk.L: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} пошле тобі допомогу зі святилища, і із Сіону нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} підтримає тебе.
uk.B: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} пошле тобі допомогу зі святого місця й підтримає тебе із Сіону.
uk.R: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} пошле тобі допомогу зі свого храму. Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дасть тобі силу з гори Сіон.

decisions.choice: the sanctuary, Zion: where God is present
decisions.reason: The sanctuary on Mount Zion in Jerusalem was where the ark stood and God was present among his people; help comes to the king from there.

decisions.choice: his temple; Mount Zion
decisions.reason: Readable names the holy place as God's temple and Zion as a mountain (m1).

records.literal_gloss: May he remember all your offerings, and your burnt offering may he find fat. Selah.

en.L: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remember all your grain offerings, \q and your burnt offering may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} accept as rich. Selah
en.B: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remember every gift you have offered \q and look with favor on your burnt offerings. Selah
en.R: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} remember all the gifts you have given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} accept the offerings you burn on the altar. Selah

fr.L: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se souvienne de toutes tes offrandes végétales, \q et que ton holocauste, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’accepte comme gras. Sélah
fr.B: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se souvienne de tous les dons que tu as offerts \q et regarde avec faveur tes holocaustes. Sélah
fr.R: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se souvienne de tous les dons que tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} as faits. \q Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} accepte les offrandes que tu brûles sur l’autel. Sélah

sw.L: Azikumbuke sadaka zako zote za nafaka, na sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa aikubali kuwa nono. Sela
sw.B: Akumbuke kila zawadi uliyotoa na kuzitazama kwa kibali sadaka zako za kuteketezwa. Sela
sw.R: Akumbuke zawadi zote ulizompa. Azikubali sadaka unazoziteketeza madhabahuni. Sela

es.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acuerde de todas tus ofrendas de cereal, \q y tu holocausto {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo acepte como rico. Selah
es.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} recuerde cada ofrenda que has presentado \q y mire con agrado tus holocaustos. Selah
es.R: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acuerde de todos los regalos que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} has dado. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} acepte las ofrendas que quemas en el altar. Selah

vi.L: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ đến mọi của lễ chay của vua, và nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chấp nhận của lễ thiêu của vua như của béo. Sê-la
vi.B: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ đến mọi lễ vật vua đã dâng và đoái nhìn các của lễ thiêu của vua. Sê-la
vi.R: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ đến mọi lễ vật vua đã dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhận những của lễ vua thiêu trên bàn thờ. Sê-la

ko.L: 그분께서 왕의 모든 곡식 제물을 기억하시고, 왕의 번제를 기름진 것으로 받으시기를 [빕니다]. 셀라
ko.B: 그분께서 왕이 드린 모든 예물을 기억하시고, 왕의 번제를 기쁘게 받아 주시기를 빕니다. 셀라
ko.R: 그분께서 왕이 그분께 드린 모든 예물을 기억해 주시기를 빕니다. 왕이 제단에서 불살라 드린 제물을 받아 주시기를 빕니다. 셀라

pt.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se lembre de todas as suas ofertas de cereal, \q e o seu holocausto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} aceite como rico. Selá
pt.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se lembre de todas as dádivas que o rei ofereceu \q e olhe com favor para os seus holocaustos. Selá
pt.R: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se lembre de todas as ofertas que saíram das suas mãos. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} aceite os sacrifícios queimados no altar. Selá

am.L: የእህል ቁርባንህን ሁሉ ያስብ፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትህንም እንደ ሰባ ይቀበል። ሴላ
am.B: ያቀረብከውን ስጦታ ሁሉ ያስብ፤ የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶችህንም በደስታ ይቀበል። ሴላ
am.R: የሰጠኸውን ስጦታ ሁሉ ያስብ። በመሠዊያው ላይ የምታቃጥለውን መሥዋዕት ይቀበል። ሴላ

hi.L: वे आपकी सब अन्नबलियों को स्मरण करें, और आपकी होमबलि को चिकनी [जानकर] ग्रहण करें। सेला
hi.B: वे आपकी चढ़ाई हुई हर भेंट को स्मरण करें और आपकी होमबलियों पर कृपादृष्टि करें। सेला
hi.R: आपने उन्हें जो भेंटें दी हैं, वे उन सबको याद रखें। आप वेदी पर जो बलियाँ जलाते हैं, वे उन्हें स्वीकार करें। सेला

ru.L: Да вспомнит {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} все твои хлебные приношения, и твоё всесожжение да примет {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} как тучное. Села
ru.B: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вспомнит каждый дар, который ты принёс, и благосклонно примет твои всесожжения. Села
ru.R: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вспомнит все дары, которые ты {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} принёс. Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} примет жертвы, которые ты сжигаешь на жертвеннике. Села

ja.L: その方が、あなたのすべての穀物のささげ物を覚え、あなたの焼き尽くすささげ物を豊かなものとして受け入れてくださるように。セラ
ja.B: その方が、あなたのささげたすべての贈り物を覚え、あなたの焼き尽くすささげ物を喜んで受け入れてくださるように。セラ
ja.R: その方が、あなたのささげたすべての贈り物を覚えていてくださるように。祭壇で焼いてささげるいけにえを、受け入れてくださるように。セラ

uk.L: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} згадає всі твої хлібні жертви, і твоє всепалення нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} прийме як ситне. Села
uk.B: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} згадає кожен дар, який ти приніс, і прихильно погляне на твої всепалення. Села
uk.R: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} згадає всі дари, які ти приніс {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} прийме жертви, які ти спалюєш на жертовнику. Села

decisions.choice: offerings: gifts of grain
decisions.reason: The word (minchah) means a gift, and in the law the grain offering (Leviticus 2:1). Before battle the king offered sacrifices (1 Samuel 13:9).

decisions.choice: find fat: accept as a rich offering
decisions.reason: The verb means to make or count fat; the fat was the best part, which belonged to the LORD (Leviticus 3:16). To find an offering fat is to accept it with pleasure.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: Selá
decisions.reason: The book keeps the unexplained word in its Portuguese spelling, "Selá", at every level here, as the English keeps "Selah" (m3).

decisions.choice: Selah as "ሴላ", at the end of its line at every level
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets for the Psalms: the meaning of the word is no longer known (meaning decision m3), so it is kept as a name, as the English keeps "Selah".

decisions.choice: "የእህል ቁርባን" (grain offering) and "የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት" (burnt offering), as the Pentateuch terms list
decisions.reason: The offerings keep the names they have in the Law.

decisions.choice: "सेला", kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: Selah is a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction (m3). As the poetry terms note settles, every level keeps it as "सेला" at the end of its verse, apart from the sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "अन्नबलियों", "होमबलि"
decisions.reason: The grain offering and the burnt offering keep the Pentateuch note's words (m1); "चिकनी [जानकर]" keeps the picture of finding the offering fat, that is, rich (m2).

decisions.choice: "Села" at the end of the verse, at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning of selah is no longer known (m3); it is probably a direction for singing or music. As the poetry note settles, every level keeps the word, "Села", where the English keeps "Selah".

decisions.choice: "хлебные приношения" (L); "всесожжение" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The minchah is the grain offering of the law (m1) and the burnt offering the olah, in the Pentateuch note's words; Balanced says "дар" as the English says "gift".

decisions.choice: minchah "穀物のささげ物" (L, as Leviticus), "贈り物" (B, R); 'olah "焼き尽くすささげ物" (L, B), "焼いてささげるいけにえ" (R); Selah "セラ" at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The offering words of the Pentateuch; the English Balanced and Readable say "gift" for minchah (m1). Selah's meaning is unknown (m3).

records.literal_gloss: May he give to you according to your heart, and all your plan[s] may he fulfill.

en.L: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} give you according to your heart, \q and all your plans may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fulfill.
en.B: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} grant you what your heart desires \q and bring every plan of yours to pass.
en.R: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} give you what you really want. \q May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let every one of your plans work out.

fr.L: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te donne selon ton cœur, \q et que tous tes projets, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les accomplisse.
fr.B: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’accorde ce que ton cœur désire \q et mène à bien chacun de tes projets.
fr.R: Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te donne ce que tu veux vraiment. \q Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse réussir chacun de tes projets.

sw.L: Akupe kwa kadiri ya moyo wako, na mipango yako yote aitimize.
sw.B: Akupe kile ambacho moyo wako unatamani na kufanikisha kila mpango wako.
sw.R: Akupe kile unachotaka kweli. Afanikishe kila mpango wako.

es.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te dé conforme a tu corazón, \q y todos tus planes {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cumpla.
es.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te conceda lo que desea tu corazón \q y haga realidad todos tus planes.
es.R: Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te dé lo que de verdad quieres. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} haga que todos tus planes salgan bien.

vi.L: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho vua theo lòng vua, và mọi mưu định của vua, nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho thành tựu.
vi.B: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho vua điều lòng vua ước muốn và làm cho mọi dự định của vua được thành tựu.
vi.R: Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho vua điều vua thật sự mong muốn. Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho mọi kế hoạch của vua đều thành công.

ko.L: 그분께서 왕의 마음대로 왕께 주시고, 왕의 모든 계획을 이루시기를 [빕니다].
ko.B: 그분께서 왕의 마음이 바라는 것을 주시고 왕의 모든 계획을 이루어 주시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 그분께서 왕이 정말 원하시는 것을 주시기를 빕니다. 왕의 계획이 하나하나 다 이루어지게 해 주시기를 빕니다.

pt.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe dê segundo o seu coração, \q e todos os seus planos {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} cumpra.
pt.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe conceda o que o seu coração deseja \q e realize cada um dos seus planos.
pt.R: Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe dê aquilo que realmente deseja. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faça dar certo cada um dos seus planos.

am.L: እንደ ልብህ ይስጥህ፤ ምክርህንም ሁሉ ይፈጽምልህ።
am.B: ልብህ የሚመኘውን ይስጥህ፤ ያሰብከውንም ሁሉ ያከናውንልህ።
am.R: በእውነት የምትፈልገውን ይስጥህ። ያቀድከውም ሁሉ እንዲሳካልህ ያድርግ።

hi.L: वे आपके मन के अनुसार आपको दें, और आपकी सब योजनाएँ पूरी करें।
hi.B: आपका मन जो चाहता है, वे आपको दें और आपकी हर योजना पूरी करें।
hi.R: आप जो सचमुच चाहते हैं, वे आपको दें। वे आपकी हर योजना को सफल करें।

ru.L: Да даст {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} тебе по твоему сердцу, и все твои планы да осуществит {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}.
ru.B: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даст тебе то, чего желает твоё сердце, и исполнит каждый твой замысел.
ru.R: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даст тебе то, чего ты по-настоящему хочешь. Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даст исполниться каждому твоему плану.

ja.L: その方が、あなたの心にかなうものをあなたに与え、あなたの計画をすべて満たしてくださるように。
ja.B: その方が、あなたの心の願いをかなえ、あなたの計画をすべて成し遂げてくださるように。
ja.R: その方が、あなたが本当に望んでいるものを与えてくださるように。あなたの計画を、一つ残らず実現させてくださるように。

uk.L: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дасть тобі за твоїм серцем, і всі твої задуми нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} здійснить.
uk.B: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дасть тобі те, чого прагне твоє серце, і здійснить кожен твій задум.
uk.R: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дасть тобі те, чого ти справді хочеш. Нехай {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дасть усім твоїм планам здійснитися.

decisions.choice: according to your heart: what you desire
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of desire and purpose. Psalm 21:3 says that God has given the king the desire of his heart.

decisions.choice: plan: counsel, a plan of action
decisions.reason: The word ('etsah) is the counsel of 1:1; here the king's plans for the battle.

source.text: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה׀בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let us shout for joy at your victory, and in [the] name of our God let us set up banners. May YHWH fulfill all your requests.

en.L: Let us shout for joy at your victory, \q and in the name of our God let us lift banners. \q May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} fulfill all your requests.
en.B: We will shout for joy when you win the day, \q and we will raise our banners in our God's name. \q May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} give you all you ask for.
en.R: Then we will shout for joy because you have won. \q We will wave our flags to honor our God. \q We pray that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give you everything you ask for.

fr.L: Crions de joie pour ta victoire, \q et au nom de notre Dieu levons les bannières. \q Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} accomplisse toutes tes demandes.
fr.B: Nous crierons de joie quand tu remporteras la victoire, \q et nous lèverons nos bannières au nom de notre Dieu. \q Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donne tout ce que tu demandes.
fr.R: Alors nous crierons de joie parce que tu auras gagné. \q Nous agiterons nos drapeaux pour honorer notre Dieu. \q Nous prions pour que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te donne tout ce que tu demandes.

sw.L: Na tushangilie kwa ushindi wako, na kwa jina la Mungu wetu tuinue bendera. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ayatimize maombi yako yote.
sw.B: Tutashangilia kwa furaha utakaposhinda, nasi tutapandisha bendera zetu kwa jina la Mungu wetu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akupe yote unayoomba.
sw.R: Ndipo tutapiga kelele za furaha kwa sababu umeshinda. Tutapeperusha bendera zetu kumheshimu Mungu wetu. Tunaomba kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakupa kila kitu unachoomba.

es.L: Gritemos de alegría por tu victoria, \q y en el nombre de nuestro Dios alcemos banderas. \q Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cumpla todas tus peticiones.
es.B: Gritaremos de alegría cuando ganes la batalla, \q y alzaremos nuestras banderas en el nombre de nuestro Dios. \q Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te conceda todo lo que pidas.
es.R: Entonces gritaremos de alegría porque has ganado. \q Agitaremos nuestras banderas para honrar a nuestro Dios. \q Pedimos que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dé todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pidas.

vi.L: Chúng ta hãy reo vui vì chiến thắng của vua, và nhân danh Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, chúng ta hãy giương cờ lên. Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm thành mọi lời cầu xin của vua.
vi.B: Chúng tôi sẽ reo vui khi vua chiến thắng, và nhân danh Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi, chúng tôi sẽ giương cao cờ xí. Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho vua mọi điều vua cầu xin.
vi.R: Rồi chúng tôi sẽ reo vui vì vua đã chiến thắng. Chúng tôi sẽ phất cờ để tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi. Chúng tôi cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho vua mọi điều vua xin.

ko.L: 우리가 왕의 승리로 기뻐 외치고, 우리 하나님의 이름으로 깃발을 세우자. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕의 모든 간구를 이루어 주시기를 빕니다.
ko.B: 왕께서 승리하실 때 우리는 기뻐 외치고, 우리 하나님의 이름으로 깃발을 높이 올릴 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이 구하시는 모든 것을 이루어 주시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 그러면 우리는 왕께서 이기셨으므로 기뻐 외칠 것입니다. 우리 하나님을 높이며 깃발을 흔들 것입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이 구하시는 것을 다 주시기를 기도합니다.

pt.L: Gritemos de alegria pela sua vitória, \q e em nome do nosso Deus levantemos bandeiras. \q Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} realize todos os seus pedidos.
pt.B: Gritaremos de alegria quando vier a sua vitória, \q e levantaremos as nossas bandeiras em nome do nosso Deus. \q Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe dê tudo o que pedir.
pt.R: Então vamos gritar de alegria pela sua vitória. \q Vamos agitar as nossas bandeiras para honrar o nosso Deus. \q Pedimos que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe dê tudo o que pedir.

am.L: በድልህ እልል እንበል፤ በአምላካችንም ስም ዓላማ እናንሣ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ልመናህን ሁሉ ይፈጽምልህ።
am.B: ድል ስታደርግ እልል እንላለን፤ በአምላካችንም ስም ሰንደቅ ዓላማችንን ከፍ እናደርጋለን። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የለመንከውን ሁሉ ይስጥህ።
am.R: ያን ጊዜ ድል ስላደረግህ በደስታ እንጮኻለን። አምላካችንን ለማክበር ሰንደቅ ዓላማችንን እናውለበልባለን። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የምትለምነውን ሁሉ እንዲሰጥህ እንጸልያለን።

hi.L: हम आपकी विजय पर जयजयकार करें, और अपने परमेश्वर के नाम से झंडे खड़े करें। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} आपकी सब विनतियाँ पूरी करें।
hi.B: जब आप विजयी होंगे, तब हम आनंद से जयजयकार करेंगे, और अपने परमेश्वर के नाम से अपने झंडे ऊँचे करेंगे। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} आपकी हर माँग पूरी करें।
hi.R: तब हम ख़ुशी से जयजयकार करेंगे, क्योंकि आप जीत गए हैं। हम अपने परमेश्वर का आदर करने के लिए अपने झंडे लहराएँगे। हमारी प्रार्थना है कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} आपको वह सब दें जो आप माँगते हैं।

ru.L: Будем ликовать о твоей победе и во имя нашего Бога поднимем знамёна. Да исполнит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} все твои просьбы.
ru.B: Мы будем ликовать, когда ты победишь, и поднимем наши знамёна во имя нашего Бога. Пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} даст тебе всё, о чём ты просишь.
ru.R: Тогда мы будем радостно кричать, потому что ты победил. Мы будем размахивать флагами, чтобы почтить нашего Бога. Мы молимся, чтобы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал тебе всё, о чём ты просишь.

ja.L: わたしたちは、あなたの勝利を喜び歌い、わたしたちの神の名によって旗を掲げよう。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたの願いをすべて満たしてくださるように。
ja.B: わたしたちは、あなたが勝利を得るとき喜び叫び、わたしたちの神の名によって旗を掲げる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたの求めるものをすべて与えてくださるように。
ja.R: そのとき、わたしたちは、あなたが勝ったことを喜んで叫ぶ。わたしたちの神をたたえて、旗を振る。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたの求めるものを、すべて与えてくださるように。

uk.L: Співаймо від радості через твою перемогу, і в імʼя нашого Бога піднімімо прапори. Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} виконає всі твої прохання.
uk.B: Ми співатимемо від радості, коли ти переможеш, і піднімемо наші прапори в імʼя нашого Бога. Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дасть тобі все, чого ти просиш.
uk.R: Тоді ми співатимемо від радості, бо ти переміг. Ми махатимемо прапорами на честь нашого Бога. Ми молимося, щоб {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав тобі все, чого ти просиш.

decisions.choice: your victory: the king's rescue and victory
decisions.reason: The word (yeshu'ah) means rescue, salvation, and in battle victory. It is the king's victory, given by God (verse 7).

decisions.choice: let us set up banners
alternatives: let us be great (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for a banner (degel, Numbers 2:2): the people raise their standards in celebration. The ancient Greek translation read a different verb, "we will be made great".

decisions.choice: let us shout, let us set up: a resolve
decisions.reason: The verbs express what the people mean to do; they are sure of the answer.

decisions.choice: wave our flags to honor our God
alternatives: set up banners in the name of our God
decisions.reason: Readable says the same in plain words (m2).

decisions.choice: yeshu'ah of the king "勝利" (every level); degel (verb) "旗を掲げる" (L, B), "旗を振る" (R)
decisions.reason: The king's rescue is his victory (m1); the banner verb is uncertain (m2), and 旗 is the Pentateuch's word for a standard.

source.text: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ׀יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Now I know that YHWH saves his anointed; he answers him from [the] heavens of his holiness with [the] mighty deeds of [the] salvation of his right hand.

en.L: Now I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saves {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will answer him from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy heavens \q with the mighty deeds of the saving [power] of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand.
en.B: Now I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brings {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anointed king through safely; \q from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy heaven {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will answer him \q with the mighty saving acts of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand.
en.R: Now I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rescues the king {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has chosen. \q From {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy home in heaven, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will answer him. \q With {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great power {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will save him.

fr.L: Maintenant je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sauve {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oint ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui répondra de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} cieux saints \q par les exploits du salut de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite.
fr.B: Maintenant je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait traverser le danger au roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a oint ; \q de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ciel saint {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui répondra \q par les puissantes délivrances de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite.
fr.R: Maintenant je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} délivre le roi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi. \q De {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte demeure dans le ciel, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui répondra. \q Par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le sauvera.

sw.L: Sasa ninajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anamwokoa masihi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; atamjibu kutoka mbingu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} takatifu kwa matendo makuu ya [nguvu za] wokovu wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume.
sw.B: Sasa ninajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anamvusha salama mfalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} aliyempaka mafuta; kutoka mbingu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} takatifu atamjibu kwa matendo makuu ya kuokoa ya mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume.
sw.R: Sasa ninajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anamwokoa mfalme aliyemchagua. Kutoka makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu mbinguni atamjibu. Kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu atamwokoa.

es.L: Ahora sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} salva a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ungido; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le responderá desde {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos cielos \q con las proezas del [poder] salvador de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} diestra.
es.B: Ahora sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lleva a salvo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rey ungido; \q desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo cielo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le responderá \q con los poderosos actos salvadores de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha.
es.R: Ahora sé que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} rescata al rey que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha escogido. \q Desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo hogar en el cielo, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le responderá. \q Con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo salvará.

vi.L: Bây giờ tôi biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cứu người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đáp lời người từ các tầng trời thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng những việc quyền năng của [sức] cứu rỗi nơi tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Giờ đây tôi biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giữ cho vị vua được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được an toàn; từ trời thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đáp lời vua bằng những việc giải cứu đầy quyền năng của tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bây giờ tôi biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giải cứu vị vua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn. Từ chỗ ngự thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên trời, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đáp lời vua. Bằng quyền năng lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cứu vua.

ko.L: 이제 나는 안다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 기름 부음 받은 이를 구원하시고, 그분의 거룩한 하늘에서 그분의 오른손의 구원하는 능력으로 그에게 응답하실 것을.
ko.B: 이제 나는 안다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 기름 부음 받은 왕을 안전하게 지키신다. 그분께서 거룩한 하늘에서 오른손의 크신 구원의 능력으로 그에게 응답하실 것이다.
ko.R: 이제 나는 안다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분께서 택하신 왕을 구해 주신다. 하늘에 있는 그분의 거룩한 집에서 그에게 응답하실 것이다. 그분의 크신 능력으로 그를 구원하실 것이다.

pt.L: Agora sei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} salva o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} ungido; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe responderá desde os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} santos céus \q com os feitos poderosos do [poder] salvador da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita.
pt.B: Agora sei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} leva em segurança o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rei ungido; \q dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} santos céus {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe responderá \q com os poderosos atos de salvação da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} mão direita.
pt.R: Agora sei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} livra o rei que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu. \q Do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo lar no céu, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhe responderá. \q Com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande poder, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o salvará.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የቀባውን እንደሚያድን አሁን አውቃለሁ፤ ከቅዱስ ሰማያቱ በቀኝ እጁ የማዳን ብርቱ ሥራዎች ይመልስለታል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የቀባውን ንጉሥ በሰላም እንደሚያሻግረው አሁን አውቃለሁ፤ ከቅዱስ ሰማዩ በቀኝ እጁ ብርቱ የማዳን ሥራ ይመልስለታል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የመረጠውን ንጉሥ እንደሚያድን አሁን አውቃለሁ። ከቅዱስ መኖሪያው ከሰማይ ይመልስለታል። በታላቅ ኃይሉም ያድነዋል።

hi.L: अब मैं जानता हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने अभिषिक्त को बचाते हैं; वे अपने पवित्र स्वर्ग से अपने दाहिने हाथ के उद्धार के पराक्रम के कामों के साथ उसे उत्तर देंगे।
hi.B: अब मैं जानता हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने अभिषिक्त राजा को सुरक्षित पार ले जाते हैं; अपने पवित्र स्वर्ग से वे अपने दाहिने हाथ के उद्धार करनेवाले पराक्रमी कामों से उसे उत्तर देंगे।
hi.R: अब मैं जानता हूँ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उस राजा को बचाते हैं जिसे उन्होंने चुना है। स्वर्ग में अपने पवित्र घर से वे उसे उत्तर देंगे। वे अपनी महान शक्ति से उसे बचाएँगे।

ru.L: Теперь я знаю, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} спасает своего помазанника; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ответит ему с небес своей святости могучими делами спасения своей правой руки.
ru.B: Теперь я знаю, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} хранит своего помазанного царя; со своих святых небес {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ответит ему могучими спасительными делами своей правой руки.
ru.R: Теперь я знаю, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} спасает царя, которого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} избрал. Из своего святого дома на небе {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ответит ему. Своей великой силой {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спасёт его.

ja.L: 今、わたしは知った。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の油注がれた者を救われる。その方は、聖なる天から、その右の手の救いの力あるわざをもって、彼に答えられる。
ja.B: 今、わたしは知っている。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分が油を注がれた王を無事に救い出される。その方は聖なる天から、右の手による力強い救いのわざをもって、王に答えられる。
ja.R: 今、わたしにはわかる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分が油を注いで立てた王を救ってくださる。天にある聖なる住まいから、その方は王に答えてくださる。大きな力で、王を救ってくださる。

uk.L: Тепер я знаю, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} спасає свого помазанця; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відповість йому зі своїх святих небес могутніми ділами спасіння {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} правиці.
uk.B: Тепер я знаю, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} рятує свого помазаного царя; зі свого святого неба {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відповість йому могутніми рятівними ділами своєї правиці.
uk.R: Тепер я знаю, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} рятує царя, якого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вибрав. Зі свого святого дому на небі {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відповість йому. Своєю великою силою {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} спасе його.

decisions.choice: I know: one voice speaks
decisions.reason: After the people's prayer a single voice speaks, perhaps a priest or prophet, or the king himself, sure that the prayer has been heard.

decisions.choice: his anointed: the king
decisions.reason: The king was anointed with oil as the one God had chosen (1 Samuel 16:13; Psalm 2:2).

decisions.choice: saves: as good as done
decisions.reason: The verb is in the past form: the rescue is so certain that it can be spoken of as done.

decisions.choice: his right hand: his power in action
decisions.reason: The right hand is the strong hand, and stands for power (Exodus 15:6).

decisions.choice: the king he has chosen
decisions.reason: Readable says what "anointed" means here (m2).

decisions.choice: his anointed "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የቀባው" (L, B); "የመረጠው ንጉሥ" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets for mashiaḥ: the anointed king (meaning decision m2); Readable follows the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "अपने अभिषिक्त" (L), "अपने अभिषिक्त राजा" (B); plain "उसे" for the king
decisions.reason: The anointed is the king (m2), "अभिषिक्त" as the poetry terms note settles, not "मसीह". When the king is spoken of rather than to, he takes plain forms, as kings do in the narrative of Samuel and Kings; the honorific forms are God's.

decisions.choice: "помазанник" (L), "помазанный царь" (B); "царь, которого он избрал" (R)
decisions.reason: His anointed is the king (m2), "помазанник" as the poetry note sets it; Readable says what anointing meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: meshicho "ご自分の油注がれた者" (L), "ご自分が油を注がれた王" (B), "ご自分が油を注いで立てた王" (R; the English Readable says "the king he has chosen"), no christos span
decisions.reason: The Psalter's form for the anointed king (m2).

source.text: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ׀בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: These in chariots and these in horses, but we in [the] name of YHWH our God make mention.

en.L: These [boast] in chariots and those in horses, \q but we in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God make mention.
en.B: Some count on chariots, some on horses; \q we call on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God by name.
en.R: Some people depend on their war chariots. Others depend on their horses. \q But we pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God and depend on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Ceux-ci [se vantent] de chars et ceux-là de chevaux, \q mais nous, du nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu nous faisons mention.
fr.B: Les uns comptent sur leurs chars, les autres sur leurs chevaux ; \q nous, nous invoquons le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu.
fr.R: Certains comptent sur leurs chars de guerre. D’autres comptent sur leurs chevaux. \q Mais nous, nous prions {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu et nous comptons sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Hawa [hujivuna] kwa magari ya vita na hawa kwa farasi, lakini sisi tunalitaja jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu.
sw.B: Wengine wanategemea magari ya vita, wengine farasi; sisi tunamwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kwa jina.
sw.R: Watu wengine wanategemea magari yao ya vita. Wengine wanategemea farasi wao. Lakini sisi tunamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu na kumtegemea.

es.L: Unos [se jactan] de carros y otros de caballos, \q pero nosotros hacemos mención del nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios.
es.B: Unos cuentan con carros, otros con caballos; \q nosotros invocamos por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios.
es.R: Algunos dependen de sus carros de guerra. Otros dependen de sus caballos. \q Pero nosotros le oramos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios y dependemos de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

vi.L: Kẻ này [cậy] xe chiến mã, kẻ kia [cậy] ngựa, nhưng chúng ta nhắc đến danh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta.
vi.B: Kẻ thì trông cậy vào xe chiến mã, kẻ thì trông cậy vào ngựa; còn chúng tôi kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi.
vi.R: Có người trông cậy vào xe chiến mã của mình. Có người trông cậy vào ngựa của mình. Nhưng chúng tôi cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi, và trông cậy nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 어떤 이들은 병거를, 어떤 이들은 말을 [자랑하지만], 우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님의 이름을 부른다.
ko.B: 어떤 이들은 병거를 의지하고 어떤 이들은 말을 의지하지만, 우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님의 이름을 부른다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 전차를 의지한다. 또 어떤 사람들은 말을 의지한다. 그러나 우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님께 기도하고 그분을 의지한다.

pt.L: Estes [se gloriam] em carros, e aqueles em cavalos, \q mas nós do nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} nosso Deus fazemos menção.
pt.B: Alguns contam com carros de guerra, outros com cavalos; \q nós chamamos pelo nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} nosso Deus.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas dependem dos seus carros de guerra. Outras dependem dos seus cavalos. \q Mas nós oramos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} nosso Deus e dependemos {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: እነዚያ በሰረገሎች፣ እነዚያም በፈረሶች [ይመካሉ]፤ እኛ ግን የአምላካችንን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ስም እናወሳለን።
am.B: አንዳንዶች በሰረገሎች፣ ሌሎችም በፈረሶች ይታመናሉ፤ እኛ ግን የአምላካችንን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ስም እንጠራለን።
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች በጦር ሰረገሎቻቸው ይተማመናሉ። ሌሎች በፈረሶቻቸው ይተማመናሉ። እኛ ግን ወደ አምላካችን ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንጸልያለን፤ በእርሱም እንተማመናለን።

hi.L: ये रथों पर और वे घोड़ों पर [घमंड करते हैं], पर हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के नाम का स्मरण करते हैं।
hi.B: कुछ लोग रथों पर भरोसा रखते हैं, कुछ घोड़ों पर; पर हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर का नाम लेकर उन्हें पुकारते हैं।
hi.R: कुछ लोग अपने युद्ध-रथों पर निर्भर रहते हैं। दूसरे अपने घोड़ों पर निर्भर रहते हैं। पर हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से प्रार्थना करते हैं और उन्हीं पर निर्भर रहते हैं।

ru.L: Эти [хвалятся] колесницами, а те — конями, а мы призываем имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога.
ru.B: Одни полагаются на колесницы, другие — на коней; а мы призываем по имени {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога.
ru.R: Одни люди надеются на свои боевые колесницы. Другие надеются на своих коней. А мы молимся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, нашему Богу, и надеемся на {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.

ja.L: ある者は戦車を、ある者は馬を[誇る]。しかし、わたしたちは、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を唱える。
ja.B: ある者は戦車に頼み、ある者は馬に頼む。しかし、わたしたちは、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名を呼ぶ。
ja.R: ある人たちは、戦車に頼る。ほかの人たちは、馬に頼る。しかし、わたしたちは、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈り、その方に頼る。

uk.L: Ці — [на] колісниці, а ті — на коней, а ми імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, згадуємо.
uk.B: Одні покладаються на колісниці, інші на коней, а ми кличемо на імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога.
uk.R: Одні люди покладаються на свої бойові колісниці. Інші покладаються на своїх коней. А ми молимося {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, нашому Богові, і покладаємося на {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.

decisions.choice: these ... these: some ... others
decisions.reason: The first two lines have no verb; it is supplied from the last: they make mention of (that is, boast of or rely on) chariots and horses.

decisions.choice: make mention: call on, boast of
decisions.reason: The verb (zakar, in this form) means to call to mind or name aloud, as in calling on a god in worship (Exodus 23:13). Israel names the LORD as its strength.

decisions.choice: chariots and horses: the strength of armies
decisions.reason: Chariots and horses were the strongest weapons of the time; Israel's kings were not to multiply horses (Deuteronomy 17:16; Isaiah 31:1).

decisions.choice: [boast]
decisions.reason: Literal brackets the verb the first lines lack (m1).

decisions.choice: and depend on him
decisions.reason: Readable makes the contrast with chariots and horses plain (m2).

decisions.choice: 'elleh … 'elleh "ある者は…ある者は" (L, B); rekhev "戦車" (every level)
decisions.reason: "These … these" means some … others (m1).

source.text: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: They bow down and fall, but we rise and stand upright.

en.L: They have bowed down and fallen, \q but we have risen and stand upright.
en.B: They will buckle and fall, \q but we will get up and stand our ground.
en.R: Those enemies will stumble and fall. \q But we will get up and stand strong.

fr.L: Eux, ils ont plié et sont tombés, mais nous, \q nous nous sommes relevés et nous tenons debout.
fr.B: Eux plieront et tomberont, mais nous, \q nous nous relèverons et tiendrons bon.
fr.R: Ces ennemis trébucheront et tomberont. \q Mais nous, nous nous relèverons et nous resterons debout, solides.

sw.L: Wao wameinama na kuanguka, lakini sisi tumeinuka na kusimama wima.
sw.B: Wao watapiga magoti na kuanguka, lakini sisi tutainuka na kusimama imara.
sw.R: Adui hao watajikwaa na kuanguka. Lakini sisi tutainuka na kusimama imara.

es.L: Ellos se han doblegado y han caído, \q pero nosotros nos hemos levantado y estamos en pie.
es.B: Ellos se doblarán y caerán, \q pero nosotros nos levantaremos y nos mantendremos firmes.
es.R: Esos enemigos tropezarán y caerán. \q Pero nosotros nos levantaremos y nos mantendremos fuertes.

vi.L: Chúng đã khuỵu xuống và ngã, nhưng chúng ta đã đứng dậy và đứng vững.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ quỵ ngã, còn chúng tôi sẽ đứng dậy và giữ vững vị trí.
vi.R: Những kẻ thù ấy sẽ vấp và ngã. Nhưng chúng tôi sẽ đứng dậy và đứng vững vàng.

ko.L: 그들은 꿇어 엎드러졌으나, 우리는 일어나 똑바로 서 있다.
ko.B: 그들은 무릎이 꺾여 쓰러지겠지만, 우리는 일어나 굳게 설 것이다.
ko.R: 그 원수들은 비틀거리다가 쓰러질 것이다. 그러나 우리는 일어나 굳세게 설 것이다.

pt.L: Eles se dobraram e caíram, \q mas nós nos levantamos e estamos de pé.
pt.B: Eles vão se curvar e cair, \q mas nós vamos nos levantar e permanecer firmes.
pt.R: Esses inimigos vão tropeçar e cair. \q Mas nós vamos nos levantar e ficar firmes.

am.L: እነርሱ ተንበረከኩ፤ ወደቁም፤ እኛ ግን ተነሣን፤ ቀጥ ብለንም ቆምን።
am.B: እነርሱ ይንበረከካሉ፤ ይወድቃሉም፤ እኛ ግን እንነሣለን፤ ጸንተንም እንቆማለን።
am.R: እነዚያ ጠላቶች ይሰናከላሉ፤ ይወድቃሉም። እኛ ግን እንነሣለን፤ በብርታትም እንቆማለን።

hi.L: वे झुक गए और गिर पड़े, पर हम उठे और सीधे खड़े हैं।
hi.B: वे लड़खड़ाकर गिर पड़ेंगे, पर हम उठकर डटे रहेंगे।
hi.R: वे शत्रु ठोकर खाकर गिर पड़ेंगे। पर हम उठेंगे और मज़बूती से खड़े रहेंगे।

ru.L: Те согнулись и рухнули, а мы поднялись и держимся прямо.
ru.B: Они пошатнутся и упадут, а мы поднимемся и устоим.
ru.R: Эти враги споткнутся и упадут. А мы поднимемся и будем стоять твёрдо.

ja.L: 彼らはかがみ込み、倒れた。しかし、わたしたちは立ち上がり、まっすぐに立つ。
ja.B: 彼らは崩れて倒れる。しかし、わたしたちは起き上がり、しっかりと立つ。
ja.R: そのような敵は、つまずいて倒れる。しかし、わたしたちは起き上がって、強く立つ。

uk.L: Вони схилилися й упали, а ми встали й стоїмо прямо.
uk.B: Вони підломляться й упадуть, а ми підведемося й стоятимемо твердо.
uk.R: Ці вороги спіткнуться й упадуть. А ми підведемося й стоятимемо міцно.

decisions.choice: they have fallen, we have risen: as good as done
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the past form, describing the coming battle as already decided; "they" are those who rely on chariots and horses.

decisions.choice: stand upright: hold firm
decisions.reason: The verb ("ud", in this form) means to stand up straight or be restored.

decisions.choice: will (future)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put in the future what is sure to happen (m1).

decisions.choice: those enemies
decisions.reason: Readable says who "they" are (m1).

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, save! May the King answer us in [the] day we call.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save! \q May the King answer us on the day we call.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save! \q May the King answer us when we cry out.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save us! \q May God our King answer us when we call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve ! \q Que le Roi nous réponde au jour où nous appelons.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve ! \q Que le Roi nous réponde quand nous crions vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve-nous ! \q Que Dieu notre Roi nous réponde quand nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelons.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uokoe! Mfalme na atujibu siku tunapoita.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uokoe! Mfalme na atujibu tunapolia.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuokoe! Mungu, Mfalme wetu, na atujibu tunapomwita.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡salva! \q Que el Rey nos responda el día en que clamemos.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡salva! \q Que el Rey nos responda cuando clamemos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡sálvanos! \q Que Dios, nuestro Rey, nos responda cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llamemos.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cứu! Nguyện Vua đáp lời chúng con trong ngày chúng con kêu cầu.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giải cứu! Nguyện Vua đáp lời chúng con khi chúng con kêu cầu.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cứu chúng con! Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời, Vua của chúng con, đáp lời khi chúng con kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 구원하십시오! 저희가 부르는 날에 왕께서 저희에게 응답하시기를 [빕니다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 구원해 주십시오! 저희가 부르짖을 때 왕께서 저희에게 응답해 주시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희를 구원해 주십시오! 저희가 부를 때 저희의 왕이신 하나님께서 응답해 주시기를 빕니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, salva! \q Que o Rei nos responda no dia em que clamarmos.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, salva! \q Que o Rei nos responda quando clamarmos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, salva-nos! \q Que Deus, o nosso Rei, nos responda quando clamarmos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አድን! በምንጠራበት ቀን ንጉሡ ይመልስልን።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አድነን! አምላካችንና ንጉሣችን ስንጠራው ይመልስልን።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, बचा! जिस दिन हम पुकारें, राजा हमें उत्तर दें।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, बचा! जब हम दुहाई दें, तब राजा हमें उत्तर दें।

decisions.choice: save! May the King answer us
alternatives: save the king! May he answer us (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text divides the verse after "save", so that "the King" who answers is the LORD himself. The ancient Greek translation joins the words differently, "LORD, save the king, and answer us", which matches the prayer for the king in verses 2-7.

decisions.choice: save us; God our King
decisions.reason: Readable supplies the object of "save" and says that the King is God (m1).

decisions.choice: "Vua" capitalised for God as King
alternatives: "vua" in lower case, as for David
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "the King" here as God, as the English does; the capital keeps him apart from the earthly king the people have called "vua" through the psalm, and "chúng con" is the people praying to him.

decisions.choice: "राजा हमें उत्तर दें", with the honorific verb
decisions.reason: The English reads "save! May the King answer us" (m1), the King being God; the honorific verb fits God, and Readable names him, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Царь" with a capital
decisions.reason: As the Hebrew text divides the verse, the King who answers is the LORD himself (m1), so Russian writes "Царь" with a capital, as the English writes "King".
